title: Generate Design Canvas Request
description: Creates one first-view design comp, not a style guide or component inventory. viewport picks the screen (desktop by default, or a portrait mobile first view) and framing picks what the first view contains (a site top page, or a landing page with a CV button and a fixed CV bar). canvas_brief, when supplied, is the text the image is grounded in instead of the raw interview text. An optional digest-bound wireframe or page screenshot (composition_reference) can ground hierarchy and composition; an optional earlier canvas of the other viewport (style_reference) keeps palette, type and composition consistent across the pair.

size.description: Defaults to 1024x1536 when viewport is omitted or mobile, and to 1536x1024 for a desktop viewport that is requested explicitly.
